//: THE TEMPLATE CHECK'S FILE SET — every .svelte file, not merely the reachable ones.
`tsconfig.json` includes 'src/**/*.ts', which does not match a .svelte path, so a
component entered svelte-check's program ONLY by being transitively imported from
some .ts root. Measured: with that file set, breaking
src/cockpit/editor/FilePane.svelte on purpose produced ZERO errors, because nothing
in the app imports it — only tests do. That is precisely the file whose missing
`frameKey` prop shipped a dead room, so a template gate that cannot see it is a
gate that would not have caught the defect it was installed for.
Naming the .svelte glob makes membership a fact about the FILESYSTEM rather than
about the import graph: a component that is unreachable, newly added, or reachable
only from a test is checked exactly like every other one. Compiler options are
inherited from tsconfig.json, so the templates are held to the same strictness as
the code — this file changes WHAT is checked, never HOW.
